## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases
Describe specific scenarios where this feature would be useful:
1. As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [benefit]
2. As a [user type], I need to [action] because [reason]

## Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Important for workflow
- [ ] High - Critical for operations
- [ ] Critical - Blocking production

## Affected Areas
- [ ] Web App
- [ ] Desktop App (Tauri)
- [ ] Mobile App (Capacitor)
- [ ] Core Packages (auth, db, ui, hooks)
- [ ] Vertical: Church
- [ ] Vertical: School
- [ ] Vertical: NGO
- [ ] Vertical: SME
- [ ] Infrastructure/DevOps
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

## Additional Notes
Any other information, configuration, or data that might be necessary to implement this feature.
